description: List the model ids available on apimodels.app, grouped by type with the endpoint each one uses. Every id listed is callable. Tool per endpoint: /v1/chat/completions → chat; /v1/images/generations → generate_image; /v1/video/generations → generate_video; /v1/audio/generations → text_to_speech (minimax-speech-*, fish-*, kling-tts) or generate_audio (music, sound effects, dialogue, dubbing, isolation); /v1/tts/stream (eleven-tts-*) → text_to_speech; /v1/embeddings → embed; /v1/media/extract → extract_media; /v1/systemone (jev) → jev_decide. The realtime voice model (wss) is not usable through MCP.
name: list_models
